Title: Shotgun grip correction and the huge Reef Leviathan
Changes: Nori holds the shotgun upright relative to the world while swimming. The barrel clears the face, with distinct trigger and foregrip hand positions.
The first Reef boss encounter now always uses the downloaded Leviathan model instead of falling back to an older generic boss.
The Leviathan is four times larger and swims horizontally. Collision, weapon hit detection, attack reach, underwater spawn clearance and depth tracking match its huge size.
Cave sharks remain separate cave guardians. Mild shotgun recoil and reliable diving are preserved.
Co-op protocol 12 keeps the giant boss model and collision consistent. All players must update together.
